d145_single_offset_channel.assumptions: Family-balanced sampling; uniform draws within each frozen pool; decoder knows pools and sees the offset but no family label, labelled seed, or outcome.
d145_single_offset_channel.scope: Not a measured effect, native-writer use estimate, or the B-only primary comparison. Conditional on a fixed family, family entropy is zero.
d145_single_offset_channel.target: family A or B with equal prior; one q=+1 offset observed

payload_arithmetic.limitations: Array payloads omit code and metadata. NL003 packed bytes are a hypothetical binary-sign encoding, not the native dense archive, and exclude positions/masks, codes and gauge information. These counts are not mutual information.

tt021_common_packet_identity_bound.assumptions: Four messages equally likely; common incoming packets and allowed setup identical within each opposite-message pair, conditional on tissue/replicate. No body, target label, label-encoding metadata or message-dependent control supplied to the decoder.
tt021_common_packet_identity_bound.scope: An upper bound implied by pairwise identity, not a decoder performance measurement; it does not assume the two pairs themselves are distinguishable.
